task.title: Pushing and pulling your first image
task.shortdesc: To push and pull your first container image in Red Hat Quay, you can log in with Podman, tag a sample image, and push it to a repository that you own.

ul.li: You can log in to your Red Hat Quay or Quay.io registry as a user.
You have a repository where you can push images, or you can create one by pushing to a new repository path.

info.p: Replace <quay-server.example.com> with your registry hostname, for example, quay.io or your Operator registry endpoint.
For standalone proof of concept registries that use self-signed certificates, you might need --tls-verify=false.
